card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a section number such as 5.1 or 2.6 in a label's parenthetical cross-reference or heading. It also fires on a few spots just before a final letter or superscript, as in m2 or HETLIOZ LQ.

modes.label: Space before section number
modes.description: The blank just after an opening parenthesis or comma and before a section number in a highlights cross-reference.

modes.label: Digit starting a section heading
modes.description: The first digit of a numbered section heading that begins right after a sentence ends.

modes.label: Before a trailing character
modes.description: A point just before a final letter or superscript attached to a product name or unit.
